purpose: Read-only comparison after user supplied ordinary Windows PowerShell policy list

user_evidence.source: Trusted transcript_evidence supplied by parent delegation

task_host.recording_method: Transcribed from completed identity and whoami query output
task_host.whoami_limitations: Non-ASCII labels/attributes were damaged by native-output decoding; only intact ASCII name and SID are relied on. Restricting SID list and exact access rule were not obtained.

windows_powershell_probe.important_exit_code_note: Probe exit code 0 means errors were caught and serialized; it does not mean policy queries succeeded.

confirmed: The current task commands run under the stated local account and a low-integrity whoami child token.
The specified original Windows PowerShell path is x64 Desktop 5.1.26100.9711 and sees the same account SID as the task Core host.
Both Windows PowerShell policy queries fail at RegistryKey.OpenSubKey through SecuritySupport.GetLocalPreferenceValue.
The exact HKCU policy key is visible but property read is denied; HKLM is visible and queried ExecutionPolicy returns null.
The user's ordinary window and the task environment have different observed policy-read outcomes.
not_proven: The user window process has the same executable path, bitness, account SID or security token as the task probe.
A specific sandbox rule, restricting SID, DACL entry or mandatory label caused the current registry denial.
Low integrity by itself explains this read denial; default MIC no-write-up does not prove a no-read-up condition.
The historical AuthorizationManager failure has exactly the same underlying cause as the present policy-query failure.
Connected/attached/authorized device status or the user's RemoteSigned output grants this task permission to run the build.

exact_remaining_gap.user_window_identity: Actual process path, version/bitness, account SID and token integrity for the window that supplied the policy list
exact_remaining_gap.denial_attribution: The exact registry key's applicable access rules and restricted-token/host denial attribution; no usable descriptor was obtained in the previous scoped ACL query
exact_remaining_gap.historical_link: Original historical error lacks an intact underlying exception stack

decisions.justification: The conditional prerequisite of proving the historical failure's environment cause is not met. No build approval is inferred.
decisions.smallest_future_formal_action: If a permission-controlled comparison is later authorized, run only the same Windows PowerShell identity + Get-ExecutionPolicy -List + exact HKCU ExecutionPolicy read through the official approval channel; no -File, compiler, game, network, or security-setting mutation.
